title: Find the percentage decrease in annual consumption from 2012 to 2013 for th
question: Find the percentage decrease in annual consumption from 2012 to 2013 for the customer who transacted at 16:25:00 on August 24, 2012. Also, report how many more 'Discount' gas stations exist in the Czech Republic than in Slovakia.

prediction.sql:
WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_013" AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS T1
    WHERE T1."XCL_011" = '2012-08-24' AND T1."XCL_012" = '16:25:00'
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(IIF(YM."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%', YM."XCL_021", 0)) AS sum_2012,
        SUM(IIF(YM."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%', YM."XCL_021", 0)) AS sum_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS YM
    INNER JOIN target_customer AS TC ON YM."XCL_019" = TC.customer_id
),
gas_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(IIF(G."XCL_006" = 'CZE', 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(G."XCL_006" = 'SVK', 1, 0)) AS diff
    FROM gasstations AS G
    WHERE G."XCL_007" = 'Discount'
)
SELECT 
    CAST((C.sum_2012 - C.sum_2013) AS REAL) * 100 / C.sum_2012 AS percentage_decrease,
    GD.diff AS gasstation_difference
FROM consumption AS C
CROSS JOIN gas_diff AS GD

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        ym.XCL_020 AS year_month,
        ym.XCL_021 AS consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON t.XCL_015 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-24' AND t.XCL_012 = '16:25:00'
),
customer_annual AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year_month LIKE '2012%' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year_month LIKE '2013%' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
discount_stations AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_007 = 'Czech Republic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cz_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_007 = 'Slovakia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sk_count
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE XCL_006 = 'Discount'
)
SELECT 
    (ca.consumption_2012 - ca.consumption_2013) * 100.0 / ca.consumption_2012 AS percentage_decrease,
    (ds.cz_count - ds.sk_count) AS more_discount_stations
FROM customer_annual ca
CROSS JOIN discount_stations ds

WITH target_customer AS (

    FROM transactions_1k AS T1

consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(IIF(YM."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%', YM."XCL_021", 0)) AS sum_2012,
        SUM(IIF(YM."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%', YM."XCL_021", 0)) AS sum_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS YM
    INNER JOIN target_customer AS TC ON YM."XCL_019" = TC.customer_id
),
gas_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(IIF(G."XCL_006" = 'CZE', 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(G."XCL_006" = 'SVK', 1, 0)) AS diff
    FROM gasstations AS G
    WHERE G."XCL_007" = 'Discount'
)
SELECT 
    CAST((C.sum_2012 - C.sum_2013) AS REAL) * 100 / C.sum_2012 AS percentage_decrease,
    GD.diff AS gasstation_difference
FROM consumption AS C
